boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named campus environments for individual, group, research, language, music, and media work.

cards.title: McCabe Library
cards.subtitle: Humanities and social sciences library
cards.notes: Settle into McCabe for reading or research, then use its public computing and varied study areas to shift from source-finding to drafting.
cards.short_summary: The College’s main library offers broad humanities and social-science support.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore identifies McCabe as its main library and describes extensive public computing resources, reading and study areas, and video-viewing rooms.
cards.access_notes: Library access and room availability can vary; confirm current details with Swarthmore Libraries.

cards.entity_name: Frank and Vera Brown Study Room (The Color Room)
cards.title: The Color Room
cards.subtitle: McCabe Library
cards.notes: Bring a visual or interdisciplinary project and use the room’s color-focused books, pigment samples, cards, and objects as concrete research prompts.
cards.short_summary: A McCabe study room devoted to interdisciplinary exploration of color.
cards.evidence_claim: The College catalog says the Color Room, formally the Frank and Vera Brown Study Room, contains books on color, pigment samples, cards, and objects for exploration.
cards.access_notes: This is a McCabe study room; ask the library about current availability or any room-use procedures.

cards.title: McCabe Thesis Carrel
cards.subtitle: McCabe Library • thesis work
cards.notes: If you are writing a thesis, request a carrel through the Libraries and use the dedicated workspace to keep research materials organized between sessions.
cards.short_summary: A reservable McCabe workspace specifically listed for thesis writers.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore Libraries’ research-help page directs students writing theses to reserve a thesis carrel in McCabe.
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; follow the Libraries’ thesis-carrel process before relying on this space.

cards.title: Cornell Science Library
cards.subtitle: Science Center
cards.notes: Use Cornell when your work needs science or engineering sources, then connect with the science librarian during weekday research-support hours.
cards.short_summary: A Science Center library supporting undergraduate STEM research.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore says Cornell Library of Science & Engineering is in the Science Center and supports student and faculty work in biology, chemistry, computer science, engineering, mathematics and statistics, and physics and astronomy.
cards.source_title: Cornell Science Library | Swarthmore College Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check Cornell’s current hours and access information with the library before your visit.

cards.title: Underhill Music and Dance Library
cards.subtitle: Lang Music Building
cards.notes: Take music or dance research here when you need scores, recordings, videos, or listening and viewing facilities alongside your reading and notes.
cards.short_summary: A performing-arts library with research collections and media-use facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The College catalog states that Underhill is in Lang Music Building and provides music and dance research collections plus listening and viewing facilities.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current library access and availability of listening or viewing facilities before planning extended work.

cards.title: Underhill Study Room
cards.subtitle: Underhill Music and Dance Library
cards.notes: For a music-focused group session, check whether the Underhill Study Room is available and bring materials that benefit from an arts-library setting.
cards.short_summary: A named study room within Swarthmore’s music and dance library.
cards.evidence_claim: A 2025 Swarthmore Music profile identifies the Underhill Study Room as a place where students worked together in Lang Music Building.
cards.access_notes: Room access and use may be subject to library procedures; contact Underhill or the Music Department to confirm.

cards.title: Language Center
cards.subtitle: Temporarily in Science Center 238
cards.notes: Use the Language Center for language, film, media, arts, or culture coursework when technology and traditional learning resources will help your project.
cards.short_summary: A flexible learning space temporarily located in Science Center 238.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore says the Language Center is temporarily located in Science Center 238 and supports study of foreign language, literature, film, media, arts, and culture.
cards.source_title: Language Center and Creative Media Commons | Swarthmore College
cards.access_notes: The location is described as temporary due to construction; contact the Language Center for current resource access.

cards.title: Creative Media Commons
cards.subtitle: Martin Hall
cards.notes: Bring a media project here when you need design, animation, or video-editing stations, and plan ahead if your work also needs specialty production facilities.
cards.short_summary: A Martin Hall media-work environment with specialized computer stations.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore reports that the Creative Media Commons opened in renovated Martin Hall with computer stations for graphic design, animation, and video editing.
cards.source_title: Creative Media Commons to Open Fall 2025 | Swarthmore ITS Blog
cards.access_notes: Confirm current access to stations, suites, recording spaces, and equipment checkout with Academic Technology.

cards.title: Beit Midrash
cards.subtitle: Jewish text study library
cards.notes: Use this collection for Jewish studies work and consult the Religion Department or Libraries when you need help locating texts or confirming access.
cards.short_summary: A joint Religion Department and Libraries resource for Jewish textual study.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore’s Religion Department describes the Beit Midrash as a joint project with the Libraries that offers access to Jewish textual interpretation and is open to all.
cards.access_notes: The official brochure says it is open to all; confirm the current location and any use guidelines before visiting.

cards.title: Martin Hall Study Space
cards.subtitle: Martin Hall
cards.notes: Use the seating area in renovated Martin Hall for coursework that benefits from being near Computer Science, Film and Media Studies, and media resources.
cards.short_summary: A documented seating area inside the renovated humanities-and-technology hub.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore Magazine describes a bright, spacious seating area in the updated Martin Hall study space and says the building houses Computer Science, Film and Media Studies, and the Creative Media Commons.
cards.source_title: Martin Hall Reimagined | Swarthmore College Magazine
cards.access_notes: This is shared academic-building seating; check building access and respect any posted room or event restrictions.
